senses.gloss:
छेदक, अस्, इका, अम्, cutting off, dividing; the
denominator of a fraction; [cf. ग्रन्थि-च्छेदक.]

छेदन, अस्, ई, अम्, cutting asunder, splitting;
destroying, solving, removing; (अम्), n. cutting,
cutting off, amputation, dividing, tearing asunder,
splitting; division; a section, a part, a portion; de-
struction, removing.

छेदनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be cut or divided,
divisible.

छेदि, इस्, इस्, इ, cutting off; breaking; (इस्), m. a
carpenter.
छेदित, अस्, आ, अम्, cut, divided.
छेदितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be cut or divided, divisible.

छेदिन्, ई, इनी, इ, cutting off, tearing off or asun-
der; destroying, removing.

छेद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be cut or divided, divisible;
to be cut off or amputated, to be split, to be muti-
lated; (अम्), n. amputation, excision; [cf. कुड्य-
च्छेद्य and पत्त्र-च्˚.]
